title: Grateful Dead Live at O'Keefe Center on 1967-08-05
source: Stereo SBD MR>R>DAT(3)>CDR(unknown number of CD gens)>EAC> Cool Edit 2000>CD Wave>SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an early‑Dead blaze, highlighted by a smoking Turn On Your Love Light and a scorching Alligator.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, well‑balanced sound (soundboard) that benefits from a little EQ but is otherwise crisp. Musically the show is charged with high energy – the first “Turn On Your Love Light” is described as pure momentum and “Alligator” is repeatedly called hot, tight, and one of the reviewer’s favorites. Overall it stands out as an early‑1970s powerhouse performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and uniformly enthusiastic comments about both the performance and sound quality indicate a top‑tier show with an excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced board mix; reviewers suggest using EQ for optimal playback but note no major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening with Turn On Your Love Light, followed by a tight Alligator later; the energy stays high throughout.
